newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa's upward momentum seen faltering.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa's upward momentum seen faltering.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Upward momentum in cocoa futures was seen waning and could mean further gains would be difficult, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"It's not going up nearly as fast as it came down, so you have to say that it's not going to meet resistance from the peak area," (near 1,050 stg per tonne in May) said Susan Rigg at Chart Analysis.
Cocoa has closed firmer in the past few days, but volume has remained low to moderate. May Cocoa was expected to open three to five stg lower from Tuesday's close.
On Tuesday, cocoa left a gap at the open between 1,013 and 1,018 and closed strongly at its session high of 1,025 stg, which some traders saw as constructive.
However, Rigg noted that recent trading around current levels has been ragged.
"It'll have to get well above there (1,050) and close above it to be convincing," she said, adding that she did not expect cocoa to rise to the task.

"I think it's going to come down again," Rigg said. "There's an awful lot of supply from the beginning of this year. I would have said it's going to have to do a lot of work and probably, it's going to drift lower during the course of that."
May support rests at 1,002, the low on Friday and Monday. Further support was seen near 974 and 962. --Medora Lee, London newsroom +44 171 542 8072
